lines.evening: Good evening. I wondered when you would come back.
lines.fire: Sit by the fire a while. The night is long, and the road will keep.
lines.clocks: Do you hear that? Every clock in the hall has stopped at the same minute.
lines.doors: No. I will not open the east doors, not tonight, and not for anyone.
lines.waiting: Perhaps I was made for waiting. Perhaps it is the thing I do best.
lines.fog: Tell me, what did you see out there, past the fog?
